hook.text: A login form asks for a username. Someone types: admin' OR 1=1 --. They get full database access.

buildup.text: SQL injection inserts malicious database commands through user input fields that aren't sanitized.

discovery.text: Parameterized queries prevent it completely by separating data from commands at the database level.

twist.text: SQL injection has been the top web vulnerability for over 20 years. It's fully preventable yet still common.

climax.text: One parameterized query replaces string concatenation. The injection attack becomes harmless text.

punchline.text: Never trust user input. Parameterize every query.
